item.title: Publicis Grows 8.8% in '25
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260204140249_020426Publicis.webp" alt="Publicis" />Publicis Groupe reports an 8.8 percent rise in 2025 net revenues to $16.4B with<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>&ldquo;every region delivering solid results at a time when our main competitors are expected to be negative overall,&rdquo; boasted CEO Arthur Sadoun.</p>
